appstore-connect.description: Server for interacting with the App Store Connect API (e.g. uploading builds, managing metadata, testflight).

firebase-mcp-server.description: Server for managing Firebase projects, deploying hosting, and interacting with Firebase CLI tools.

github.description: Server for interacting with GitHub (e.g. creating PRs, managing issues, reading repositories).

ios-simulator.description: Server for interacting with the iOS simulator, testing apps, and simulating user interactions.

render.description: Server for interacting with Render infrastructure, managing services, databases, and cron jobs.

xcode-bridge.description: Server for controlling Xcode projects, building targets, running tests, and managing workflows.

swiftlens.description: Server for analyzing Swift source code, understanding project structure, and generating module insights.

notebooks.description: Server for reading, editing, and managing Jupyter notebooks.

visualization.description: Server for generating visual charts and graphs from structured data.

pyscn-mcp.description: Server for analyzing Python source code complexity, cohesion, and potential structural issues.

playwright.description: Cross-browser automation (Chromium, Apple Safari WebKit, Firefox) via Playwright. Use for interactive web navigation, clicking elements, video playback, form filling, and taking screenshots.
